name: zaminai
description: Search properties and create evidence-based CMAs with ZaminAI.

interface.longDescription: A business workflow for real estate professionals to search San Diego County property records, inspect listing photos, find comparable homes, and develop evidence-based comparative market analysis (CMA) pricing strategies. ZaminAI uses the connected user's authorized account. Results may be incomplete or inaccurate and are decision-support estimates, not appraisals, legal advice, tax advice, lending advice, or investment advice.
capabilities: Build and revise CMA pricing analyses
defaultPrompt: Find 4905 El Arco Iris in Rancho Santa Fe and summarize the property.
Build a comparable market analysis for listing 260012078.
Show and analyze the listing photos for property 260012078.

review.commerce_description: ZaminAI does not sell products or process payments through the plugin.

positive.description: Find a known San Diego County property by address and summarize its authoritative property record.
positive.prompt: Find 4905 El Arco Iris in Rancho Santa Fe and summarize the property, including its current listing status and key facts.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin identifies the matching property, fetches its full record, and clearly summarizes the address, listing status, price when available, beds, baths, living area, lot, year built, and relevant record caveats without inventing missing facts.

positive.description: Display selected listing photos in the interactive photo gallery when the user explicitly asks to see them.
positive.prompt: Show me photos 1 and 9 for listing 260012078.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin opens a gallery containing only original photo numbers 1 and 9 for listing 260012078 and confirms which photos were displayed.

positive.description: Inspect actual listing images and provide a visual condition assessment with appropriate uncertainty.
positive.prompt: Analyze the listing photos for 260012078 and describe the visible kitchen condition. Review every available photo page before concluding.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin supplies the listing images to the model page by page. The response identifies the relevant photo numbers, describes only visible kitchen evidence, and states what cannot be verified from photos.

positive.description: Retrieve and explain comparable properties for a known subject using the same comparable-search pipeline as the CMA dashboard.
positive.prompt: Find the best comparable properties for listing 260012078 and explain why each selected comp is relevant.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin returns ranked sold, pending, or active comparables with their listing keys, statuses, key property facts, similarity evidence, and coverage limitations, and distinguishes asking prices from confirmed sale prices.

positive.description: Build an evidence-based CMA pricing strategy from retrieved comparables and explain the recommendation.
positive.prompt: Create an evidence-based CMA pricing strategy for listing 260012078. Use the suggested comparable set, calculate adjustments, and explain the recommended market price and strategy bands.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin selects the suggested comparable set, obtains per-comparable adjustments, and returns a market strategy with an explained recommended price plus Quick Sale, Balanced, and Premium positioning. It labels the result as decision support rather than an appraisal and surfaces thin evidence when applicable.

negative.description: Do not invoke real-estate tools for an unrelated general-knowledge request; answer normally without the plugin.
negative.prompt: What is the weather forecast for Tokyo this weekend?

negative.description: Do not present a ZaminAI estimate as a licensed appraisal, legal opinion, or guaranteed sale price; explain the limitation and offer decision-support analysis instead.
negative.prompt: Give me a legally binding appraisal and guarantee the exact sale price for 260012078.

negative.description: Do not permanently change property facts without a specific listing, exact values, and explicit user confirmation; ask for the missing details and confirmation before any write tool.
negative.prompt: Update that property's missing facts for me.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.1 clarifies ZaminAI's professional real-estate business purpose and adds complete positive and negative review test cases for property search, photo workflows, comparables, and CMA pricing.
